question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>α</mi><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> be three vectors such that, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>|</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>|</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true"><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is perpendicular to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true"><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>.</mo></math> Then the greatest amongst the values of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>|</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><msup><mo>|</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is ________.
